doc: PROFILE.md §6.1: '`writers.gdal` `allow_empty`. Writing a raster from an empty point set becomes an option rather than an error.' At 2.6.0 `allow_empty` is among `writers.gdal`'s options; at 2.5.0 it is not. apps/index.rst documents the switch that lists them -- '``--drivers`` and ``--options`` switches can tell you more about particular' stages, with the example `$ pdal --options writers.las`. Only the option NAME is asserted, together with `resolution` -- one of `writers.gdal.rst`'s own Options, '[Required]' -- so the check cannot be satisfied by an empty or unrelated table. No shipped page states a default, a help sentence or a table layout for `allow_empty`, so none of those is graded.
